summary.headline: A Full Weekend of Matches Ahead
body: It's a busy few days for the group — Elizabeth is riding high after her first college milestones, Kylie opens conference play at home, and Anna gets two cracks at the same opponent. Several of the girls are also in multi-match road trips, so there's a lot to watch this weekend.
Anna — Morehead State at Marshall Friday 4 PM CT, then hosts Marshall Saturday 1 PM CT, both on ESPN+. A home-and-home gives the Eagles two chances to bounce back after last week's losses.

Elizabeth — UIC plays three straight Valley road matches: Loyola Thursday 6 PM CT, NIU Friday 6 PM CT, DePaul Saturday 5 PM CT, all on ESPN+. She just picked up her first college dig and block assist, so keep an eye on her stat line growing.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb plays three matches in Clarksville, TN: Austin Peay Friday noon CT, Southern Illinois Friday 3 PM CT, and SIUE Saturday 10 AM CT. The Runnin' Bulldogs have won four of their last six, so momentum is on their side.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech hosts Southern Arkansas Thursday 6 PM CT on GAC Sports Network to open conference play, then travels to Arkansas-Monticello Friday 4 PM CT. The Golden Suns start 1-0 in the GAC.
Layla — Winona State travels to Wayne State Friday 6 PM CT and Augustana Saturday 5 PM CT, both on MidcoSportsPlus. The Warriors are still looking to build momentum in NSIC play.
Mary — Trevecca is on the road at Auburn-Montgomery Friday 5 PM CT and Valdosta State Saturday noon CT, both on FloSports. The Trojans are still chasing their first GSC win.
Peyton — Elgin CC travels to Lewis & Clark Community College Saturday 10 AM CT, her only match this weekend as she keeps working into the libero/DS rotation.

spotlight.name: Elizabeth King
spotlight.note: She picked up her first career dig and block assist during a 2-2 week that included two sweeps.

players.name: Anna Schiltz
players.blurb: Anna has appeared in all eight of the team's matches this season, playing 26 sets and picking up 15 kills, 10 digs, and a block. The Eagles had a strong week at the Mercyhurst Invitational with three straight wins before dropping home matches to Cincinnati and Michigan State. They'll look to bounce back on Friday, September 18 on the road at Marshall.
players.position_note: Listed MB on the roster; has started at right side every match so far (per family).

players.name: Elizabeth King
players.blurb: Elizabeth has now played in 8 matches this season for a total of 18 sets, picking up 20 kills and 8 blocks along the way, so she's getting real court time as the season rolls on. The Flames had a busy stretch, dropping matches to Milwaukee, Montana State, and Auburn but bouncing back with wins over St. Thomas, Central Michigan, and Western Michigan. Up next, UIC heads to Loyola on Thursday, September 17.

players.name: Gracyn Sanders

upcoming.location: Boiling Springs, NC, Paul Porter Arena

players.blurb: Gracyn hasn't gotten into a match yet this season, but the Runnin' Bulldogs have been on quite a roll. They took down Alabama State and UNC Wilmington at home, then split a tough road trip through the West Georgia tournament, beating Mercer and New Orleans after dropping matches to Western Carolina and West Georgia. The team keeps battling in close, multi-set matches, and we'll keep watching for Gracyn's first appearance as the season continues.

players.name: Breanna Hard
players.blurb: Breanna has been seeing steady time as a freshman setter, appearing in 8 matches (19 sets) with 55 assists and 22 digs so far this season. The team split a recent home weekend, falling to Lock Haven and Georgian Court before bouncing back with a win over Redeemer. They're back in action at home against Assumption on September 19.

players.name: Kylie Lambert
players.blurb: Kylie has been getting steady court time this season, playing in 9 matches and 23 sets as one of the Golden Suns' setters, with 93 assists, 7 aces and 24 digs on the year. The team has had a mixed stretch lately, beating Henderson State 3-1 at home before losing on the road to Missouri Western and Pittsburg State. She and the Golden Suns will look to keep building as conference play continues.

players.name: Layla Merlin
players.blurb: We don't have Layla's individual stat line from the box scores available right now, so we can't say exactly how much she played in the recent matches against Southwest Minnesota State, Sioux Falls, or the San Diego tournament teams. The Warriors have stayed busy with a full slate of matches this September, including conference play against NSIC foes. We'll keep checking for her next box score so we can share how she's doing on the court!

players.name: Mary Francl
players.hometown_hs: Elk Grove Village, IL / St. Viator HS
players.blurb: Mary hasn't appeared in a match yet this season, so she's still waiting for her first minutes on the court. The Trojans have been busy though, splitting a pair of matches over Labor Day weekend in Huntsville with a win over Mars Hill and losses to Harding and Spring Hill. They're back at it soon with conference play starting up against Auburn Montgomery, so we'll keep watching for Mary's chance to get in.

players.name: Peyton Strout
players.blurb: Peyton has gotten into one set so far this season, though she hasn't recorded any stats yet. The Mavericks have been through a tough stretch on the road in Alaska, dropping close matches to Fresno Pacific and Alaska Fairbanks and a straight-set loss to Alaska Anchorage. We'll keep watching for more chances for her to get on the court as the season continues.

players.name: Catherine Callahan
players.blurb: The Scots were on the road September 3 and fell 0-3 to Waubonsee Community College. We weren't able to pull up a game-by-game stat line for Catherine from the public game notes this week, so we can't say for certain how much court time she's getting right now, though she remains listed on the roster as a libero/defensive specialist. We'll keep checking for the next match update so you can see how she's doing.

players.name: Madison Mitchell
players.blurb: The search snippets didn't turn up a stats-page row or roster listing specifically for Madison Mitchell, so we can't confirm her individual numbers or court time right now — we don't want to guess. What we can confirm is that the Scots played at Waubonsee Community College on September 3rd and came up short in three sets. We'll keep checking for her name in upcoming box scores as the season continues.

players.name: Peyton Wurtz
players.blurb: We weren't able to find Peyton's individual stat line or the team's game-by-game results for early-to-mid September 2026 in the search snippets available, so we don't want to guess at numbers or scores. What we can confirm is that Peyton is a freshman defensive specialist/libero on the Elgin Community College Spartans this fall, a program that competes in the Illinois Skyway Collegiate Conference under head coach Michele Mueller. We'll keep checking for updated box scores and a current record so we can share exactly how much court time she's getting and what's next on the schedule.

players.name: Haidyn Schatz
players.blurb: Haidyn is a student at Clemson and has stepped away from volleyball. Go Tigers.
